name: 奥伦修斯
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_一_灰的年月.md:1356
gear: 传奇（约 LVL 205）｜中（三川城书记官家）｜不打仗（主祭，祷告那一路，不带兵器）｜5档（不披甲）｜他是走祷告那一路的主祭、一辈子不带兵器，纷争纪元年到3年在圣城一句话不说，第三格换成站着抬手的姿势；身上只是帝国剩下的主祭袍和耶万主祭的铜印，旧铜线符文里缝着曜核的那几处还微微亮。
who: Orentius, a human legend, high priest of the temple of Yevan the war god in the Star Crown holy city, the man who wrote the first verdict against the horned; over a thousand years old and looking about fifty, unchanged since he became a legend: about 178 cm, lean and upright. Iron-grey hair cut short and combed back, a neat short grey beard. Deep-set steel-blue eyes that look first into a person's eyes and do not look away. Two deep lines between the brows. A heavy old-bronze high priest's seal hangs on a chain at his chest. Since that night he has not said a word. A severe, diligent, weary air; not cruel, and he keeps cats.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, severe man's face of about fifty, NOT young: deep-set steel-blue eyes with fine lines at the corners, two deep vertical lines between the brows, iron-grey brows, a straight thin nose, a thin closed mouth in a neat short grey beard, slightly hollow cheeks.
build: about 178 cm, lean and upright: narrow straight shoulders, long thin hands.
palette: deep crimson and iron grey, old bronze, ivory white, ink black
casual: His temple robes: a long iron-grey wool robe to the ankles that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a deep crimson stole over the shoulders bordered with old bronze thread gone dull, a narrow black belt; the heavy old-bronze seal of Yevan's high priest on a chain at his chest. He holds a small closed wooden box in both hands, the pen he wrote with locked inside it. A grave, silent look.
private: Alone in his cell at night: a plain long-sleeved undyed wool robe buttoned to the throat, soft slippers, the seal set aside. A grey tabby cat lies in his arms, one long thin hand resting on its back, a tired, unreadable look.
battle: In the war god's temple through the ash years: the iron-grey robe under a high priest's ceremonial half-mantle of dark crimson, its old bronze-thread runes still glowing faintly where an old core is stitched into the hem, the bronze seal at his chest lit a dull warm gold, a closed book of records under his left arm. He carries no weapon and does not fight: he stands perfectly still, the right hand raised with the palm forward as if halting someone, a cold, silent stare.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: standing perfectly still and upright, the right hand raised with the palm forward as if halting someone, a closed book held under the left arm, a cold, silent stare; he carries no weapon and does not fight.
formal: Presiding at the high altar: a long ivory-white vestment over the grey robe, a deep crimson cope heavy with old bronze embroidery of a sword laid across a shield, fastened at the chest with a bronze clasp, the bronze seal on its chain, bareheaded. He stands with both hands resting on the closed wooden box, a severe look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait in a dim temple, the face turned slightly, the steel-blue eyes looking straight into the viewer's eyes without blinking, the mouth closed, a weary, unreadable look. Cold grey ash-light from a high window on one side, a single candle's warm glow on the other. Foreground blur: the ear of a sleeping cat and drifting ash. He wears the iron-grey robe and the crimson stole.
